title: The whole-plan reviewer's verdict on every entry of the plan's ledger

candidate.description: The plan's tip these verdicts were formed against: the commit the whole-plan check was given.

verdicts.description: Exactly one entry per ledger entry handed over. An entry with no verdict, or with more than one, is not re-judged.

id.description: The ledger entry's id, copied unchanged from the ledger.

verdict.description: resolved: the tip no longer has the problem. still-real: the problem is present, and a change in this plan's code can fix it. needs-person: the problem is present, but only a person or a re-plan settles it.

evidence.description: What in the tip settles it: the file and what it now does, or what is still wrong and why no code change answers it.
